hooks.name: schema-migration-guard
hooks.description: Check schema-related changes for a safe Alembic migration and baseline compatibility.

action.prompt: A schema-related file was saved. Inspect the changed file and current git diff. Determine whether the change requires a new Alembic revision, whether enums and constraints remain aligned with the eldercare_ai baseline, and whether tests cover upgrade and rollback behavior. Never modify an applied migration or frozen baseline, never run alembic --autogenerate, and never run downgrade/base, docker down -v, or another destructive database command automatically. Report the required migration or verification work.
